prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Presenting complaints included low back pain radiating into the left buttock, with stiffness and muscle guarding in the lumbar paraspinal region. Neurological examination revealed intact strength, sensation, and reflexes in the lower extremities. Straight leg raise was negative bilaterally. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Diagnosis: lumbar strain, acute, related to the collision.

Treatment consisted of 17 visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, supplemented with a short course of muscle relaxant and anti-inflammatory medication. Pain and range of motion improved steadily across visits. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported pain reduced to occasional mild discomfort with daily activities, and lumbar flexion had returned to near normal. Residual stiffness with prolonged sitting persists. Prognosis is good. Patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen.
